title: Chapter 673
text:
Rumble —

The armed satellite fortress was plowed by the Mech Legion over and over again. The four Calamity Grades no longer surrounded Han Xiao but ran for their lives.

Han Xiao was distracted by the Virtual Intrusion. Destroying the armed satellite fortress was his mission. After killing Tamaria, the other four did not dare attack him again, and no one interrupted him.

The various abilities of his Virtual Technology had been upgraded multiple times. Han Xiao did not spend too much effort and successfully obtained control of the armed satellite fortress. The technical ability of a Grade A + Virtual Mechanic was enough to defeat most artificial intelligences.

Han Xiao searched through the control module of the armed satellite fortress and sighed.

"There's no self-destruct module. Bad review."

After thinking about it, Han Xiao controlled the armed satellite fortress to open a path to the surface. He then sent a portion of his mechanical soldiers into the interior of the armed satellite fortress to plant secondary psionic bombs.

In terms of efficiency, detonating the energy furnace inside the armed satellite fortress was much more convenient than destroying the armed satellite fortress from the outside.

…

At the same time, on the main battlefield …

A few agile small spaceships shuttled through the chaotic battlefield. The Calamity Grades sent by Morred and the others were on the spaceships. They were trying to break through the enemy's blockade and reinforce Han Xiao.

However, the high-energy particle cannons crisscrossed the battlefield. These support teams were forced back time and time again by the dense cannon fire. It was difficult for them to break through the firepower net of the enemy spaceships.

As waves of Bloodshed Land fleets arrived at the battlefield through the fast reinforcement channel, the pressure on the main force increased exponentially. They could no longer provide complete cover for these support teams.

"The situation isn't good. We've dragged it out for too long. The troops of a few enemy strongholds have already shaken off the troops that were restraining them and are rushing to reinforce the base station. The number of enemies we're facing has increased by a few times!"

In the flagship, Morred's expression changed when he heard the report from the observer.

He clenched his teeth tightly, and his cheeks puffed up. His voice sounded like it was coming from the gaps between his teeth.

"If this continues, we'll only obtain a Pyrrhic victory at most! Black Star is the key to breaking the stalemate quickly, but he's alone now. Will the helpers we sent be unable to break through the blockade? "

"No, the enemy seems to have seen through our intentions. They have completely sealed off the route leading to the satellite fortress where Black Star is," the observer said.

Morred's eyes flashed with valiance, and his expression became resolute. He waved his hand and said, "Pass down my order. All troops, tighten the formation and advance from this direction. We will open a path for the support team and pierce through the enemy's defense line!"

As soon as he finished speaking, the expressions of everyone in the command room changed as shock appeared on their faces.

The current situation on the battlefield could be described as a five-layered chocolate ball. The situation was clear at a glance.

The outermost layer was occupied by Morred and the other three Section Zero fleets, while the second layer was occupied by the defense fleet of the base station.

Behind the defense fleet was the super-large protective shield of the base station. With this layer as the boundary, it separated the outer battlefield from the base station core. Further inside was the nine satellite fortresses surrounding the base station. In the center of the 'chocolate ball' was the target that Section Zero wanted to destroy, T-04 Hyperdrive Base Station.

Morred's order was to have the entire fleet penetrate deep into the enemy's defense line alone to open a path for Black Star's team. This move was tantamount to giving up on the path of retreat and entering the enemy's territory.

Once the main force pierced through the enemy's defense line but failed to break through the base station's protective shield, it would be equivalent to them falling into a dead end.

"This is a gamble tactic. It's too risky!"

"I don't agree with such a radical method. It's better to fight steadily."

As soon as he said that, many of the captains protested. They belonged to another organization and were not Morred's direct subordinates.

The weakness of an alliance was once again revealed. When faced with a crisis that required them to take risks, the hearts of the people were not united. Compared to the situation on the battlefield, more people were more inclined to care about their own losses.

Rebuttals sounded in the communication channel, and Morred's expression became uglier. Only the New Phylen Revolutionary Army's fleet was his direct subordinate. However, this number was not enough, and he needed the help of other organizations.

Bang!

Morred could not take it anymore and slammed the table, interrupting the protests of the captains.

"I know that all of you want to gain the favor of Amethyst Civilization and become a long-term partner of a Star Cluster Civilization. However, if you don't put your lives on the line, do you think the Amethyst Civilization is easy to fool? "I've had enough of being defeated by Bloodshed Land time and time again. Now, the opportunity is right in front of us. His Excellency Black Star is fighting a bloody battle. As long as we help him, we will be able to break this stalemate and obtain victory! "You're all large organizations in your respective Star Systems, and you're all famous. Why have you become a bunch of cowards? "If you don't even dare to take a little risk, forgive me for being blunt, but what's the point of participating in this war?"

The communication channel instantly fell silent, and no one spoke.

Seeing this, Morred did not waste any more time and said with a deep voice, "Execute the order!"

The entire fleet no longer pushed forward slowly. Like a hammer, they slammed heavily into the formation of the base station's defense fleet!

The shields of the battleships withstood the attacks from all directions, and they charged toward the armed satellite fortress where Han Xiao had landed.

At first, the enemy fleet was in a mess, but they quickly adjusted their formation and blocked Morred's fleet.

Not long after, Morred's fleet no longer had the momentum they had at the start. It was as if they had fallen into a swamp, unable to move forward. At this time, they had already reached the depths of the blockade line and were only a short distance away from the armed satellite fortress' protective shield.

However, this distance seemed to take ten times longer for Morred's fleet to cross.

"Hold on, the armed satellite fortress is right in front of us!"

The flagship was under fire, and the command room shook slightly. Morred ordered loudly, "Support team, it's your turn. Seize the opportunity to land!"

At this time, the atmosphere on the support team's ship was tense.

The Calamity Grade captain leading the team had a solemn expression as he loudly ordered the others.

"Everyone, prepare for battle. His Excellency Black Star needs our help. Let's go!"

The next moment, these Calamity Grades jumped out of their spaceships and agilely took a detour. Using the majority of the fleet as a barrier, they finally broke through the blockade and headed straight for the armed satellite fortress under Morred's nervous gaze.

Morred looked at the Calamity Grade Supers with hope as they approached the armed satellite fortress.

Whether they could win or not depended on this!

However, just as he was feeling nervous, something happened!

Just as the reinforcement team approached the defensive shield outside the armed satellite fortress, they saw the armed satellite fortress inside suddenly emit a strong light and suddenly explode!

The entire armed satellite fortress expanded from the inside out and shattered. This space fortress that looked like an asteroid turned into a dazzling explosion of light in the blink of an eye!

The shockwave swept out, and countless armor, parts, and machinery were blown away, turning into floating space trash. The sound was like a planet exploding!

With the destruction of the armed satellite fortress, the base station's protective shield lost one of its ends. The protective shield in this area instantly evaporated, revealing a huge hole that was large enough for the fleet to enter.

Behind the hole was the Hyperdrive Base Station that had lost its protection.

The path to the enemy's core was opened!

A figure flew out from the wreckage of the armed satellite fortress. It was Han Xiao.

The sudden change attracted the attention of the entire battlefield. Be it friend or foe, they all looked over with shock on their faces.

Black Star had blown up the armed satellite fortress alone?

The Mech Legion had been retrieved, and Han Xiao left the wreckage of the armed satellite fortress with dozens of Army Boxes. There were quite a few burn marks on his mechanical suit.

He immediately saw the members of the support team who were hovering in the air. He waved his hand to greet them and sent a voice message.

"You guys are late."

The members of the support team were mentally prepared to fight a bloody battle, but at this moment, they felt as though they had punched cotton. They looked at Han Xiao in a daze.

W-where are our enemies?

Don't tell me they were all killed by you?

Everyone was shocked.

Just how many Calamity Grades had Black Star killed?

"Well done!"

Morred was stunned for a moment before he shouted excitedly with an expression of ecstasy.

He had thought that Black Star was being held back by the enemy and had no reinforcements. However, it seemed that the situation was completely different from what he had guessed!

Who would have thought that Black Star would be able to blow up the satellite under the pressure of so many Calamity Grade Supers?

What a reliable batch!

The protective shield had been broken in such a timely manner. It was a godsend opportunity.

Without time to think about anything else, Morred seized the opportunity and gave the order. The entire fleet broke through the blockade and entered through the hole in the protective shield, firing madly at the base station.

…

At the same time, the base station was being bombarded, and the interior was in chaos. Ear-Piercing alarms echoed in every corner.

"Warning! Warning! High energy attack detected! "

Outside the window, bright cannons were like the countdown of death, quickly approaching.

In the main control room, the base station commander looked out of the porthole, his lips trembling, and his face twitching with fear. Like all the workers beside him, he revealed a look of despair.

He did not understand why Black Star was so much stronger than what the intelligence said.

He had sent five Calamity Grade Supers to reinforce Tamaria and the others as a precaution against the experts coming to reinforce Black Star. However, he did not expect that while these five Calamity Grade Supers were still on the way, Black Star had already killed Tamaria!

That was the strongest person guarding the base station!

She was killed just like that?

When the five reinforcements arrived, the four Calamity Grade Supers following Tamaria were either dead or injured. They were completely crushed. Black Star was in a valiant state. He then turned around and defeated the five Calamity Grade Supers that had arrived!

Black Star alone had defeated more than half of the high-level combatants guarding the base station!

What was the use of the intelligence report?

This completely messed up all their plans. The base station commander was completely stunned, and his mind went blank.

Facing such a suppressive high-level combatant, he felt helpless and could only watch as Black Star turned the satellite fortress into fireworks.

Time seemed to have been stretched out, and the cannons were getting closer and closer. The dazzling light reflected on the base station commander's face and filled his vision. It was as though he had fallen into a white world.

At this moment, there was only one thought left in his mind.

I just … lost to Black Star.

…
